page.layout: One page of text, single column, with running head top left and page number top right. Title line and address centred below the text. Letter opening with a drop-cap "A". Catchword bottom right, signature bottom centre-left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: propter triumphatos à te hostes tuos exulto & gestio, atque etiam ut gratitudinis qua tibi arctissime devinctus sum, qualecunque monumentum, meiqve tibi obse-quentissimé addicti ne sis immemor. De-us vota tua, & consilia secundet, & Emi-nentiam tuam Ecclesiae suae & literis in-columem diutissime conservet.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXXVII
Card. Barberinus ad[?] Morino.D. Feronii Pietas & Doctrina commendatur.
main_text.p: Admodum Reverendo Patri D. Joanni Morino Presbytero.

ADmodum Reverende Pater, D. Fe-ronium Illustrissimi Carnutensium Episcopi Vicarium generalem suae virtutes ac doctrina commendare sat po-terant; maxima tamen iis accessio facta est ex luculento adeo testimonio, nam quem tanta judicii sui[?] laude exornat or-natissimus Morinus, eum plurimi ab om-nibus faciendum censeo; video itaque, ad quam me officii rationem excitet, & tanti

page.notes: The initial "sui" in "judicii sui" is partly broken and read as "sui". The symbol after "Barberinus" is doubtful and read as "ad". The catchword "pondus" and signature "Cc 5" are at the foot of the page and are not repeated in the text. Long s is normalised to s. The title is in italic mixed with roman type.
